texts.title: Aeschylus, Prometheus Bound 436-525: the arts Prometheus gave to mankind
texts.source: Florence, Laur. Plut. 32.9 (Medicean Aeschylus) fol. 152v-153v via Teca digitale BML + Smyth Greek (Perseus) + Smyth English (Loeb 1922, archive.org scan)
texts.description: Prometheus, chained to his rock, tells the chorus how mankind lived like shapes in dreams until he gave them the stars, numbers, letters, the yoke, ships, medicine, divination and metals: 'every art possessed by man comes from Prometheus'. Shown on the 10th-century Medicean manuscript, Laur. Plut. 32.9.
